statement: For every rational prime ell congruent2 or5 modulo9, the actual relative pro3 arithmetic group unramified outside ell and3 is the free pro3 product of its tame local decomposition group at ell and Z3, with an explicitly normalized complex-conjugation action. For every first class3(a kappa3(ell)+b kappa3(3)), a nonzero, the full global H section fiber is Z3^2 times a specified restricted prime product times Z3^v3(3a) times Z3[[Z]], with the exact toric map and unique integral cocycle representatives.

notes: The arithmetic isomorphism preserves actual tame inertia and Frobenius; a coset-tree kernel comparison proves injectivity. Complex conjugation is normalized inside the relative pro3 quotient over C2, and its root change is transported by an explicit element of H. The proof computes every twisted additive cocycle and all remaining geometric conjugacies. Integral division follows from equality of the closed principal ideals, and finite invariant orbits give v3(3a) extra coordinates. A c-equivariant arithmetic splitting and the additive free-inertia map give every global residue lift; its exact correction at3 is retained. The finite program checks39 complete recoveries,702 integral series coefficients,15 cyclic orbit systems and11172 residue/order/log/affine comparisons. The intrinsic maps retain their previously computed kernels.
